coverage.main: Read all thirteen pages of cached arXiv 2103.15571v3 (13 August 2021), including both appendices. Visually checked PDF pp. 5-8 and 13 for setup, Tables 1-4 and all quantitative figures.
coverage.supplement: Retrieved the three-page CVF supplement from the link on the official landing page, read all text and visually inspected all three pages. Sections A/B and Figures 6-9 overlap the arXiv appendix; count these experiments once. Figure 7 text extraction is unreliable, so used the rendered page to confirm its labels and scope.
coverage.excluded_results: Figures 1 and 6 are illustrative images, Figure 2 is an algorithm relationship diagram. Source-model points and starred cells in Tables 1-3 are white-box results. Table 4 averages are summaries, not additional independent observations. C&W and other attacks mentioned only as related work are not additional empirical result groups.

result_groups.population: Stated 1,000-image ILSVRC2012 validation sample; four sources, seven evaluation models
result_groups.outcome: off-diagonal target misclassification for MI, NI, VMI and VNI attacks
result_groups.evidence: Almost-correct classification is not a target-clean-error exclusion rule. Section 4.2 defines success as misclassification on adversarial images, but does not explicitly define source-failure retention/exclusion. Released basic evaluator behavior is separately recorded without asserting full published-scope correspondence.

result_groups.locator: Section 4.3; Figure 3 p. 6; Appendix B pp. 11,13, Figures 7-9; CVF supplement pp. 1,3
result_groups.population: Same stated dataset; four single source models, each with six other target models
result_groups.outcome: target misclassification for MI/NI/VMI/VNI combined separately with DIM, TIM or SIM
result_groups.evidence: The appendix extends the main source-model comparison to three more sources without adding an explicit denominator conditioning statement. Main and supplementary copies of Figures 7-9 are not counted twice.

result_groups.population: Four single sources and six off-diagonal targets per source on the stated dataset
result_groups.outcome: target misclassification for MI/NI/VMI/VNI with composite input transformation
result_groups.evidence: The attack transformation changes, but no explicit clean-correct or successful-source denominator policy is supplied.

result_groups.population: Equal-logit ensemble of four normally trained sources; three adversarially trained targets
result_groups.outcome: target misclassification for eight basic/composite attack variants
result_groups.evidence: Ensemble logits are defined; source-ensemble success filtering and target-clean filtering are not explicit. Four starred source columns do not establish off-diagonal denominators.

result_groups.locator: Sections 4.1,4.5; Table 4 upper block, PDF pp. 5,7
result_groups.population: Inception-v3 source against nine advanced defense pipelines
result_groups.evidence: No explicit denominator conditioning is established for all nine defense pipelines. The root evaluator covers basic models, not all these pipelines. Version-specific target choices in third_party/README.md must be retained.

result_groups.locator: Sections 4.4-4.5; Table 4 lower block, PDF p. 7
result_groups.population: Four-model source ensemble against nine advanced defense pipelines
result_groups.evidence: Neither a successful-ensemble-source denominator nor a target-clean exclusion rule is explicit. Randomized-smoothing and other defense evaluation settings require their own population and aggregation verification.

result_groups.population: Inception-v3 source against six other models; varying beta at N=20 and N at beta=1.5
result_groups.evidence: White-box success is reported as 100% for these settings, but that alone is not a statement of denominator policy. Beta and N tune gradient-neighborhood sampling rather than define new final perturbation budgets.

f1.evidence: The near-correct dataset description supplies no model-specific numerical clean accuracies for all source and target pipelines. Attacked diagonals are not clean accuracies. No separate complete set was located.

f2.locator: Section 4.1 dataset description; basic evaluator and defense notes
f2.evidence: Almost-correct wording does not explicitly exclude target-clean-incorrect inputs. An evaluator with no clean-prediction input does not establish whether the source dataset was prefiltered, and the basic path cannot establish all defense populations.

f3.evidence: Released simple_eval.py explicitly retains source failures, but coverage of every published table, ensemble and defense path is not established. Preserve that affirmative code finding without converting unresolved published scopes to no.

f4.evidence: One-decimal rates on exactly 1,000 unaveraged trials may recover unique counts. Final denominators, stochastic-defense aggregation and exact plotted values are not established across all groups; no original per-example conditioning record was located. Survey-generated CSVs are not an author release.

f5.locator: Section 2 norm definition; Section 4.1 hyperparameters; Section 4.6 and Appendix B
f5.evidence: The paper specifies L-infinity and epsilon=16 for its gradient-sign experiments, with 10 steps and alpha=1.6. All inventoried variants and ablations retain this setup; beta controls the gradient-sampling neighborhood, not the final input-space radius. Released vmi_fgsm.py normalizes epsilon as 2*16/255 on [-1,1] inputs. No separately evaluated unbounded baseline was located.

f6.locator: Pinned root README, evaluator, attack and third_party materials
f6.evidence: Executable-looking attack/evaluation sources and public folder listings for data and eight checkpoint names were located. Downloaded bytes, population identity, checkpoint loading and original-runtime execution were not verified. The local archive uses a PyTorch port and SSA-derived data/weights; those do not establish sufficiency or numerical parity of this original release.

artifact_checks.result: Remote HEAD matches local 9c87680732108fefa0d3cb5f22d76715c3010a6c. Lines 137-157 count target ground-truth misclassification for every loaded adversarial filename, without successful-source filtering or clean predictions, and divide by constant 1,000. Eight basic models are evaluated, including an extra adversarial Inception-v3. This is code-path evidence, not proof of all published rate denominators or upstream dataset selection.

Defaults match the stated VMI epsilon=16, 10 steps, alpha=1.6 pixel units, momentum=1, N=20 and beta=1.5. Graph fixes its attack label from the initial source prediction (lines 169-170), whereas Algorithm 1 names a ground-truth input label. Gradient neighbors are not clipped; final iterates are clipped to the epsilon/input box. This is not original-runtime parity or a post-PNG budget check.

Maintainer note distinguishes conference Table 4 from revised arXiv: some Bit-Red/FD/NRP conference results use IncRes-v2_ens while others use Inc-v3_ens3; revised results align these targets. Root README separately identifies Resnet_101 for ComDefend, whereas Section 4.1 broadly assigns Inc-v3_ens3 to defenses other than HGD/R&P/NIPS-r3/RS. Keep this configuration ambiguity explicit; no numerical version delta computed. RS.sh specifies noise=.25, N=100, skip=100 and external conversion/evaluation helpers; was read, not executed.

bounds_checks.locator: Section 4 and appendix/CVF supplement; released defense notes
bounds_checks.reason: No numerical clean accuracy for the actual target pipeline on the reported-rate population was established. Near-correct wording is not a quantitative clean-error rate. Do not borrow port clean accuracies or use a conference-version target with an arXiv-version rate. No new numerical bound extracted.

limitations: Complete denotes a documented non-blind evidence review, not independent agreement or original-runtime recomputation.
The arXiv version is pinned because released notes identify target changes; a full numerical conference-versus-arXiv comparison remains unperformed.
Public file listings are positive availability evidence, not proof of checkpoint/data identity or execution sufficiency. Historical coding and archived runs remain unchanged.
